ComfyUI LoRA 培训准备工作流程（使用 Flux1.d）
此 ComfyUI 工作流程旨在通过自动化来简化 LoRA 训练的数据集准备工作批量图像放大和注释凭借的力量通量1.d。它可以处理整个图像文件夹，利用 Flux1.d 的高级图像生成和增强功能来提升图像的清晰度和细节。升级后，它自动运行标记/注释生成描述性标题，将其保存在每张图像旁边，以实现无缝 LoRA 训练集成。

主要特点：

  • Flux1.d 图像增强：利用 Flux1.d 放大和细化图像，确保训练数据的高分辨率、高保真度。

  • 批处理：轻松处理大型图像集，使其成为大规模数据集创建的理想选择。

  • 自动注释：为每个图像生成标题或标签（通过 Florence），大大减少手动标记工作。

  • LoRA 就绪输出：以针对 LoRA 训练工作流程优化的结构输出整齐配对的图像和文本文件。

  • 完全集成 ComfyUI：拖放功能、模块化节点设置和清晰的可视化工作流程使定制变得轻松。

此工作流程非常适合想要高质量、一致的数据集同时最大限度地减少准备时间。

ComfyUI LoRA Training Prep Workflow (with Flux1.d)
This ComfyUI workflow is built to simplify dataset preparation for LoRA training by automatingbatch image upscalingandannotationwith the power ofFlux1.d. It processes entire folders of images, leveraging Flux1.d’s advanced image generation and enhancement capabilities to upscale images with exceptional clarity and detail. After upscaling, it runs automatedtagging/annotationto produce descriptive captions, saving them alongside each image for seamless LoRA training integration.

Key features:

  • Flux1.d Image Enhancement:Utilizes Flux1.d to upscale and refine images, ensuring high-resolution, high-fidelity training data.

  • Batch Processing:Handles large image sets with ease, making it ideal for dataset creation at scale.

  • Automated Annotation:Generates captions or tags for each image (via Florence), drastically reducing manual labeling effort.

  • LoRA-Ready Output:Outputs neatly paired image and text files in a structure optimized for LoRA training workflows.

  • Fully ComfyUI-Integrated:Drag-and-drop functionality, modular node setup, and a clear visual workflow make it easy to customize.

This workflow is perfect for AI creators and LoRA trainers who wanthigh-quality, consistent datasetswhile minimizing prep time.
